title: ASP.NET Web API Examples
description: Each example belongs to one starter lesson. Follow its setup steps before trying it. These examples need the named tools and do not run in this site playground.

examples.title: Make a controller action
examples.description: A controller action handles a route. HttpGet maps GET /hello to the method.

examples.title: Return a JSON object
examples.description: Ok creates a successful response with data. Open GET /book.

examples.title: Bind a route number
examples.description: FromRoute reads a path value. Open GET /double/4.

examples.title: Read a query input
examples.description: FromQuery makes the source of an input clear. GET /page with no n uses 1.

examples.title: Read a typed body
examples.description: FromBody reads a JSON request body. Send POST /books with application/json and {"title":"Moon Trip"}.

examples.title: Use a required field rule
examples.description: ApiController checks validation attributes. A valid POST /books with {"title":"Moon Trip"} reaches this action.

examples.title: Return a new item location
examples.description: CreatedAtAction sends status 201 and a link to the new item. Send POST /books with {"title":"Moon Trip"}.

examples.title: Report a missing book
examples.description: NotFound creates a 404 result. Open GET /missing.

examples.title: Return a typed collection
examples.description: A collection becomes a JSON array. Open GET /books.

examples.title: Set a controller response header
examples.description: A controller can set response metadata before returning a result. Open GET /note.

examples.title: Reply without a body
examples.description: NoContent returns status 204. Send DELETE /books/1 for this practice response.

examples.title: Choose between result kinds
examples.description: IActionResult allows different outcomes. GET /score/8 returns a success; a negative score returns 400.
